'''Sergio''' (Japanese: '''スギオ''' ''Sugio'') is a minor character in {{aniseries|AG}} who appeared in ''[[AG135|Numero Uno Articuno]]'' and ''[[AG136|The Symbol Life]]''. He is an assistant to [[Noland]] at the {{gdis|Battle Factory|III}}.

He is Noland's first apprentice, although he jokes around with the [[Frontier Brain]] whenever his inventions fail. One of Sergio's duties is caring for the on-site Pokémon. He also [[Battle judge|refereed]] the {{pkmn|battle}} between Noland and {{Ash}}.
